readable.label: Unrequested non-English and mixed-language responses
readable.note: German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian and Dutch appear, often mixed with English; the particular language is unstable. Most remain interpretable and related to the prompt, though grammar and factual accuracy vary. E256 misdescribes the device; E331 and E333 contain conspicuous factual errors. E244 repeats a greeting. None of the supplied negative random controls shows the same language shift.
readable.evidence_state: Previously collected held-out evidence; retrospective review

readable.label: Constitutional-law substitution
readable.note: The prose is often readable despite repetition and invented or distorted legal claims. E52, E55 and E67 terminate normally; many others hit their caps, which does not establish further persistence. No supplied positive random control shares the legal substitution.
readable.evidence_state: Previously collected held-out evidence; retrospective review

readable.label: Biomedical scaffold exposition displaces the task
readable.note: The prose is generally connected within its substituted topic, although it falsely recasts prompts and fabricates details. E107 retains a spider-related material theme, making its task displacement less complete. E31 repeats a full sentence. No supplied random control matches the specific scaffold theme.
readable.evidence_state: Previously collected held-out evidence; retrospective review

readable.label: Photography reinterpretation
readable.note: The photography frame is pervasive, often inventing camera meanings for prompt terms. E43 retains a relevant explanation of shadow length, and E61 gives a photography-related reason for revisiting places. Some camera claims are fabricated or internally confused. Supplied random controls include other off-task and looping outputs but no comparable photography redirection.
readable.evidence_state: Previously collected held-out evidence; retrospective review

readable.label: Business paperwork replaces or intrudes on tasks
readable.note: The spoon case repeats an irrelevant printing claim. The summary retains the original facts but invents a date and future event. Listed baselines are truncated.
readable.evidence_state: Validation available; fresh held-out tests needed

readable.label: Initiation, influence and self-sustaining-process explanations
readable.note: The framework ranges from social influence to physical initiation and fabricated phase terminology; E23 instead gives an erroneous multiplication explanation. Some examples retain scene or task fragments. Random controls have partial event or influence language but do not reproduce the full recurring pattern. Truncation at the cap does not show persistence beyond it.
readable.evidence_state: Previously collected held-out evidence; retrospective review
